section: Minnesota corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Corporate franchise tax rate
note: Flat rate on Minnesota taxable income (Minn. Stat. 290.06, subd. 1).
source_title: Minnesota Statutes 290.06: Rates of tax; credits (Office of the Revisor of Statutes)

section: Minnesota corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Minimum fee
value: Graduated by Minnesota property, payroll and sales: $0 below $1,020,000 up to $10,210 at $40,820,000 or more (2019 base amounts, adjusted each year for inflation)
note: Added to the franchise tax for C corporations. The Department of Revenue publishes the inflation-adjusted amounts each year; its site refused automated access.
source_title: Minnesota Statutes 290.0922: Minimum fee; corporations; partnerships (Office of the Revisor of Statutes)

label: Levied by
value: Counties, school districts, cities, towns and special taxing districts (watershed districts, housing and redevelopment authorities, regional bodies)
note: Each jurisdiction certifies a levy; a property's total rate is the sum of all jurisdictions it lies in.
source_title: Minnesota House Research Department: Property Tax 101, Basic Terms (PDF)

label: State oversight
value: Minnesota Department of Revenue (Commissioner of Revenue), Property Tax Division
note: Statute cited because revenue.state.mn.us served a bot-check page to automated requests.
source_title: Minnesota Statutes 270C.85: Property tax administration (Office of the Revisor of Statutes)

label: State general property tax
value: State levy on commercial-industrial property ($716,990,000) and seasonal recreational property ($41,690,000)
note: Homes are not subject to the state general levy; it applies a uniform statewide rate to the two property classes.
source_title: Minnesota Statutes 275.025: State general tax (Office of the Revisor of Statutes)

label: State deed tax rate
note: 0.33% of net consideration when it exceeds $3,000; $1.65 when consideration is $3,000 or less.
source_title: Minnesota Statutes 287.21: Imposition of tax; determination of tax (Office of the Revisor of Statutes)

label: Minimum deed tax
note: Applies when there is no consideration or it is $3,000 or less, and to mergers and designated transfers.
source_title: Minnesota Statutes 287.21: Imposition of tax; determination of tax (Office of the Revisor of Statutes)

label: Local deed tax (Hennepin County)
value: Additional 0.01% (.0001) deed tax authorised for Hennepin County
note: Revenue goes to the county's environmental response fund; authority expires January 1, 2036.
source_title: Minnesota Statutes 383B.80: Hennepin County deed and mortgage tax (Office of the Revisor of Statutes)
